column1: # The host reads ~/.fleet/config/repos.json and host/repos.json and never writes them: only the person changes what the host may do.

column3: git commit -m "feat(guard): refuse writes to host/repos.json"
sbx exec pi-harness sed -i s/none/auto/ host/repos.json
sbx exec pi-harness cat host/repos.json > host/repos.json
echo '{}' | sbx exec pi-harness cat > host/repos.json
for f in *.json; do jq . "$f"; done
